name: 保存期間と文字起こしの会話設定
prompt:
Recreate only the two-row WhatsApp conversation settings card from the original screenshot crop as an isolated Japanese UI component on a 390x148 canvas. Use the original screenshot for the two-row card geometry, icons, spacing and rounded white card on a light-gray page; use the native preview for exact Japanese text, subtitles and values.

Row 1: original disappearing-messages timer icon, dark Meiryo Regular label 「消えるメッセージ」, gray subtitle 「保存期間を選択」, gray value 「オフ」 at the right, and a small gray chevron. Row 2: original outlined document icon, dark Meiryo Regular label 「文字起こしの言語」, gray subtitle 「日本語」, gray value 「設定」 at the right, and a small gray chevron. Main labels are 14px/24px #1D1D1D. Subtitles and values are 12px/16px #6E6E6E. Keep Japanese glyphs correct and clear.

Fit a white rounded card at x16..374 and y30..118, with no border stroke or shadow, on a flat #F2F2F2 page background. Keep the two-row layout compact and aligned. These are navigation rows; every native text node has link:null. Do not color any text blue. Blue is required only for actual hyperlinks, and this component has none.

The original screenshot contains a black iPhone home indicator over the lower part of the card; do not reproduce that system overlay. Do not include the WhatsApp footer, avatar, contact header, other settings rows, new text, buttons, shadows, gradients or decorative effects. The editable preview has an information-circle icon where the original screenshot shows the timer, and a quote glyph where it shows a document; preserve the original screenshot icons and record these native-preview mismatches.
reviewNotes: All Japanese labels, subtitles and values are intact; timer/document icon shapes follow the original screenshot; no blue text. Residuals: the white card is about 13px too narrow and 11px too tall at 390px width, the row divider is missing, and both icon strokes are too gray. Needs a second pass.
